c01.name: Ace of Cups
c01.image: A hand from a cloud holds an overflowing chalice; a dove lowers a wafer into it and five streams pour out
c01.up: A new feeling starting; the heart opens
c01.down: A heart kept shut, or emotion swallowed
c01.work: A start that comes from the heart

c02.name: Two of Cups
c02.image: A man and a woman exchange their cups; above them a staff with two snakes and a winged lion's head
c02.up: A two-way bond between equals; two people choosing each other
c02.down: A mismatch, or a bond that has gone one-sided

c03.name: Three of Cups
c03.image: Three women raise their cups and dance together; fruit and flowers scattered at their feet
c03.up: Shared joy and support from the people around you; something worth celebrating
c03.down: A cold crowd, gossip, a celebration that went too far
c03.love: Friends backing the relationship, a celebration

c04.name: Four of Cups
c04.image: A youth sits under a tree, arms folded, staring at three cups; a hand from a cloud offers a fourth
c04.up: Boredom and flatness; something is being offered and you are not looking at it
c04.down: Coming out of the slump, seeing what is actually there
c04.love: Indifference toward the relationship you already have
c04.work: No drive left for the job

c05.name: Five of Cups
c05.image: A figure in a black cloak looks down at three spilled cups; two more still stand behind, and a bridge crosses a river far off
c05.up: Grief and regret; something is still intact that you have not turned around to see
c05.down: Accepting the loss and turning back, or staying in the ache
c05.love: The sadness of an ending, regret

c06.name: Six of Cups
c06.image: A child hands a cup of white flowers to a smaller one; old houses around them, a guard walking away
c06.up: The past and memory; someone or something from back then comes round again
c06.down: Stuck in the past, or finally putting it down
c06.work: A return to the earlier path

c07.name: Seven of Cups
c07.image: A dark figure faces seven cups in the clouds: a head, a veiled shape, a snake, a castle, jewels, a wreath, a dragon
c07.up: Too many options and daydreaming; one of them has to be made real
c07.down: The choice gets clear, or an illusion breaks
c07.love: Several options, or an imagined picture of someone

c08.name: Eight of Cups
c08.image: A man with a staff turns his back on eight cups and climbs toward the mountains; the moon above him
c08.up: Leaving something that is no longer enough and walking on
c08.down: Staying out of doubt, or going back to the same thing
c08.love: Leaving a relationship that is not working
c08.work: Walking away from work with nothing left in it

c09.name: Nine of Cups
c09.image: A satisfied man sits on a bench, arms folded; nine cups lined up on a curved table behind him
c09.up: Contentment and a wish granted; the thing you actually wanted
c09.down: Surface satisfaction, or a wish that has not landed yet

c10.name: Ten of Cups
c10.image: A couple hold each other, two children dance beside them, ten cups arc across a rainbow overhead
c10.up: Family happiness and a calm that holds
c10.down: A tense household, or happiness kept up for show

c11.name: Page of Cups
c11.image: A well-dressed youth holds a cup with a little fish poking its head out; a choppy sea behind
c11.up: News or a fresh feeling arriving; a curious heart
c11.down: Childish feelings, or news that never came
c11.love: A message from someone, a gentle start
c11.work: An idea that comes from the heart

c12.name: Knight of Cups
c12.image: A calm rider in a winged helmet holds a cup out in front; his white horse walks toward a stream
c12.up: An offer or a move made on feeling; someone is coming closer
c12.down: An empty promise, or feeling put on for show

c13.name: Queen of Cups
c13.image: A queen on a throne at the water's edge studies a closed, ornate cup; the throne's foot stands in the water
c13.up: Deep empathy and reading people without words
c13.down: Drowning in feeling, or going cold
c13.love: Someone warm and intuitive in the story

c14.name: King of Cups
c14.image: A king on a throne afloat on a rough sea holds a cup and stays calm; a fish leaps, a ship sails by
c14.up: Steady in the middle of heavy feeling; someone who holds themselves together
c14.down: Feelings pushed down, or emotional manipulation

s01.name: Ace of Swords
s01.image: A hand from a cloud lifts a sword point up; a crown rests on the tip with olive and palm branches
s01.up: A truth coming into the open; the clean, decisive call
s01.down: Fog, or a truth that was never put to use
s01.love: The blunt conversation that clears everything up
s01.work: A clear decision, the idea that wins

s02.name: Two of Swords
s02.image: A blindfolded woman holds two crossed swords at her chest; behind her the sea, rocks and a crescent moon
s02.up: A stalemate; you are keeping one side of it out of sight
s02.down: The blindfold comes off and the truth shows
s02.love: A decision left hanging in the relationship

s03.name: Three of Swords
s03.image: A red heart pierced by three swords; behind it a dark cloud and falling rain
s03.up: Plain heartbreak; a truth that hurts but has been said out loud
s03.down: Healing starting, or pain that will not be put down

s04.name: Four of Swords
s04.image: A stone knight lies on a tomb, hands in prayer; three swords hang above him and one lies beneath
s04.up: Enforced rest; you have to stop long enough to get your strength back
s04.down: Back into the field, or restlessness during the break
s04.love: A short distance taken to cool down
s04.work: Leave, a pause that is needed

s05.name: Five of Swords
s05.image: A smirking man holds three swords and watches two figures walk off; two more swords left on the ground
s05.up: A win that cost the relationship; a hollow victory
s05.down: Making up, or the grudge that stays
s05.work: Competition that is not worth the price

s06.name: Six of Swords
s06.image: A ferryman poles a boat carrying a woman and a child; six swords stand in the bow, calmer water ahead
s06.up: Crossing out of a hard stretch toward quieter water
s06.down: Held back by the past, or a trip that got delayed
s06.love: Moving away from a heavy atmosphere
s06.work: A move, a change of setting

s07.name: Seven of Swords
s07.image: A man tiptoes off with five swords and leaves two stuck in the ground; tents and people behind him
s07.up: Secrecy or cleverness; someone is not telling the whole story
s07.down: The secret comes out, or a confession
s07.love: A lie, something kept hidden in the relationship
s07.work: Going behind backs, a private plan

s08.name: Eight of Swords
s08.image: A bound, blindfolded woman stands among eight planted swords; her feet are free, the ground is muddy
s08.up: The feeling of being trapped, mostly built by the mind; the way out is open
s08.down: Getting free, or settling into the victim role
s08.love: Feeling shut in by the relationship
s08.work: The sense of a career dead end

s09.name: Nine of Swords
s09.image: Someone sits up in bed at night, head in hands; nine swords lined up on the wall behind
s09.up: Anxiety and sleepless nights; fear of what has not happened yet
s09.down: Coming out of the nightmare, or sinking further into it

s10.name: Ten of Swords
s10.image: A man lies face down with ten swords in his back; the sky is black but the horizon is lightening
s10.up: Rock bottom; the worst part is over and it does not go lower
s10.down: Getting up slowly, or clinging to the victim role
s10.love: A bitter ending, but a final one

s11.name: Page of Swords
s11.image: A youth on a hill grips a raised sword and glances around; the wind drives the clouds
s11.up: Curiosity and carrying news; eyes and ears everywhere
s11.down: Rumor, a word said without thinking
s11.work: Work news, something new to learn

s12.name: Knight of Swords
s12.image: A rider charges at full gallop, sword raised; the horse and his cloak stretched out by the wind
s12.up: A direct charge with no build-up; speed over everything else
s12.down: Haste that wrecks things, or aggression
s12.love: Someone who arrives fast and leaves fast

s13.name: Queen of Swords
s13.image: A queen on a throne, sword point up in one hand, the other reaching forward; sharp clouds, a bird above
s13.up: Bluntness with no padding; someone sharpened by hard experience
s13.down: Too cold and bitter, or cutting criticism
s13.love: Someone direct and independent in the story

s14.name: King of Swords
s14.image: A man on a stone throne holds a slightly tilted sword; his gaze is straight ahead, clouds gathering
s14.up: Logic and mental authority; a ruling made with the head
s14.down: The power of words misused, or rigidity
s14.love: Someone rational and a little cold

p01.name: Ace of Pentacles
p01.image: A hand from a cloud holds a large coin; below it a garden with a flowered arch and a path to the mountains
p01.up: A real money or job opening; something solid is starting
p01.down: An opening missed, or a start that got pushed back
p01.love: A relationship with a solid base

p02.name: Two of Pentacles
p02.image: A youth dances, spinning two coins in a ribbon shaped like an infinity sign; two ships ride high waves behind
p02.up: Juggling two things; for now both can be held
p02.down: Losing the balance, too much at once
p02.love: Splitting time between the relationship and the rest of life

p03.name: Three of Pentacles
p03.image: A sculptor stands on a bench at work in an unfinished church; two people beside him hold the plans
p03.up: Team work and skill that gets noticed; building something that lasts
p03.down: Work out of step, or skill that goes unseen

p04.name: Four of Pentacles
p04.image: A man clutches a coin to his chest, one balanced on his crown and one under each foot; a town behind
p04.up: Gripping what you have; there is safety but no movement
p04.down: Opening the fist, or a sudden splurge

p05.name: Five of Pentacles
p05.image: Two people in rags, one on crutches, cross the snow past a lit church window without looking in
p05.up: Lack and the feeling of being left outside; there is help you have not seen
p05.down: Things picking up, or staying in the sense of being deprived
p05.work: Money trouble, being out of work

p06.name: Six of Pentacles
p06.image: A merchant holds scales in one hand and with the other drops coins to two kneeling beggars
p06.up: Help or generosity arriving; but the two sides are not equal
p06.down: Help with strings on it, or an uneven debt
p06.love: One side giving more than the other

p07.name: Seven of Pentacles
p07.image: A farmer leans on his hoe and pauses to look at a bush loaded with seven coins
p07.up: A pause to take stock; it is planted but not ready to pick
p07.down: Impatience, or effort that bore nothing
p07.love: Weighing whether this relationship is worth what it costs
p07.work: Waiting for an investment to pay off

p08.name: Eight of Pentacles
p08.image: A craftsman on a bench chisels a coin; six finished ones hang on the post beside him and one lies on the ground
p08.up: Practice and repetition; the skill is being built
p08.down: Soulless, repetitive work, or a sloppy job
p08.love: Steady effort to build the relationship

p09.name: Nine of Pentacles
p09.image: A woman in a vineyard with a hooded falcon on her hand; nine coins among the vines, a manor house far off
p09.up: Independence and the harvest of your own work; standing on your own feet
p09.down: Financial dependence, or solitude you did not choose
p09.love: Someone who is already complete on their own
p09.work: Independent income, the fruit of years of work

p10.name: Ten of Pentacles
p10.image: An old man with two dogs, a young couple and a child under the arch of an old house; ten coins across the scene
p10.up: Wealth and family roots; something that stays
p10.down: A fight over inheritance, or roots that have loosened

p11.name: Page of Pentacles
p11.image: A youth holds a coin up in both hands, absorbed in it; a green field and trees behind him
p11.up: Learning and a fresh plan; a careful first step
p11.down: No drive, or a plan that never got carried out
p11.work: Work news, the start of learning

p12.name: Knight of Pentacles
p12.image: A still rider on a heavy black horse holds up a coin; a ploughed field in front of him
p12.up: Slow but sure progress; someone who does what they promised
p12.down: Slowness that grates, or a standstill

p13.name: Queen of Pentacles
p13.image: A queen on a throne among flowers holds a coin in her lap; a rabbit jumps in the corner of the card
p13.up: Practical care and full hands; someone who provides and builds
p13.down: Swallowed by daily chores, or neglecting yourself

p14.name: King of Pentacles
p14.image: A king on his throne, robe embroidered with grapevines, coin in hand and a castle behind; armor under the robe
p14.up: Wealth and security already built; someone who has arrived
